message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters, so "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The bug was in `vendor/slugify`, which is version 1.2.0 and drops accented letters. Its changelog says 1.2.1 fixes this, but the vendor folder is marked "do not edit by hand". I couldn't upgrade it from here, so I changed `src/blog/slug.js` instead. It now removes the accent marks before calling `slugify`.

The shop URLs in `src/shop/product-url.js` also use slugify, so they probably have the same bug. I didn't touch them. Replacing the vendor folder with 1.2.1 would fix both places, and you could then delete the workaround in `slug.js`.
